headline: Founder Operations, Cash-Flow Discipline & Customer Trust
summary: Actionable playbooks for founders, independent operators, and team leaders scaling sustainable revenue and compliance.

advice.title: Track Cash Conversion Weekly
advice.guidance: Monitor accounts receivable aging and fixed burn rate every Friday so growth initiatives stay self-funded.
advice.actionStep: Audit upcoming 60-day invoices and set a dedicated tax-reserve target.

advice.title: Turn Customer Feedback Into Proof
advice.guidance: Capture short post-delivery case studies with concrete metrics to shorten future sales cycles.
advice.actionStep: Request one brief testimonial from a satisfied client this week.

advice.title: Document Core SOPs Early
advice.guidance: Lightweight repeatable checklists for onboarding, billing, and QA let small teams delegate without losing quality.
advice.actionStep: Write a 5-step checklist for your highest-frequency client workflow.
